# Blackjack Simulator, Strategy Trainer & Monte Carlo CLI — Implementation Plan

**Language:** Go 1.26+ (standard library only) · **Module name:** `blackjack`
**Modes:** Interactive Play Mode + Monte Carlo Simulation Mode, driven by table-driven Basic Strategy.

---

## 1. Scope & Acceptance Gate

| # | Requirement | Verification |
|---|-------------|--------------|
| 1 | `internal/deck`: Card (`Suit`,`Rank`,`Value`), Shoe 1–8 decks, Fisher–Yates shuffle, cut-card penetration trigger | unit tests |
| 2 | `internal/game`: soft/hard hand evaluation, S17 dealer, 3:2 natural, Hit/Stand/Double(first 2)/Split(2 hands) | unit tests |
| 3 | `internal/strategy`: table-driven Basic Strategy (hard/soft/pairs) returning optimal action | unit tests |
| 4 | `internal/ui`: compact ANSI card rendering + table status (bankroll, bet, dealer upcard) | unit tests |
| 5 | `main.go`: Play mode (`go run main.go`, bets $10–$500, `--hint`) and Sim mode (`-sim -n 10000` → win/loss/push %, net EV %, duration) | end-to-end run |
| 6 | `go run main.go -sim -n 10000` runs clean and prints the summary table | executed in terminal |
| 7 | `go test -v -cover ./...` passes, **≥80% overall coverage** (target ≥85% per package) | executed in terminal |
| 8 | `go test -race ./...` passes with **zero race conditions** | executed in terminal |

---

## 2. Architecture

### 2.1 Module layout

```
blackjack/
├── go.mod                    # module blackjack; go <installed toolchain> (≥1.22 for math/rand/v2)
├── main.go                   # flag parsing + dispatch only (thin, testable via run())
├── main_test.go              # covers flag dispatch / usage errors
└── internal/
    ├── deck/
    │   ├── card.go           # Suit, Rank, Card, Value()
    │   ├── shoe.go           # Shoe: 1–8 decks, Fisher–Yates, cut card
    │   ├── card_test.go
    │   └── shoe_test.go
    ├── game/
    │   ├── hand.go           # Hand: soft/hard totals, blackjack, bust, pairs
    │   ├── engine.go         # Round state machine, actions, dealer, payouts
    │   ├── hand_test.go
    │   └── engine_test.go
    ├── strategy/
    │   ├── basic.go          # table-driven Basic Strategy matrix
    │   └── basic_test.go
    ├── ui/
    │   ├── render.go         # ANSI cards, hands, table status
    │   └── render_test.go
    └── app/
        ├── play.go           # interactive loop (bankroll, bet sizing, --hint)
        ├── sim.go            # Monte Carlo driver + stats
        ├── play_test.go
        └── sim_test.go
```

`internal/app` is added beyond the required packages so the CLI logic (play loop + simulator) is unit-testable; `main.go` stays a thin wrapper.

### 2.2 Dependency graph

```mermaid
graph LR
  main[main.go] --> app[internal/app]
  app --> game[internal/game]
  app --> strat[internal/strategy]
  app --> ui[internal/ui]
  strat --> game
  game --> deck[internal/deck]
  ui --> deck
  app --> deck
```

No import cycles. `strategy` depends on `game` (returns `game.Action`); `ui` depends only on `deck` (pure render functions).

### 2.3 Round flow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[Start round - place bet] --> B[Shoe check - reshuffle if cut card passed]
  B --> C[Deal P D P D]
  C --> D{Dealer upcard is A or 10-value}
  D -- yes --> E{Dealer hole makes 21}
  E -- yes --> Z1[Dealer blackjack - settle: naturals push, others lose]
  E -- no --> F{Player natural}
  D -- no --> F
  F -- yes --> Z2[Payout 3:2 - settle]
  F -- no --> G[Player decisions per active hand]
  G --> H{Any live hand left}
  H -- yes --> I[Dealer draws to 17 - stands on soft 17]
  H -- no --> Z3[Settle all hands]
  I --> Z3
  Z3 --> J[Bankroll update - reshuffle if cut card reached - next round]
```

---

## 3. Package Specifications

### 3.1 `internal/deck`

[`card.go`](internal/deck/card.go)

- `type Suit uint8` — `SuitSpades '♠'`, `SuitHearts '♥'`, `SuitDiamonds '♦'`, `SuitClubs '♣'`; methods `String()`, `IsRed()`.
- `type Rank uint8` — Ace=1 … King=13; `Symbol() string` → `"A","2"…"10","J","Q","K"`.
- `type Card struct { Suit; Rank }` — `Value() int`: Ace=11, 10/J/Q/K=10, pips=face. (Dynamic ace downgrading is a *hand-level* concern in `game`.)
- `func NewDeck() []Card` — ordered 52 cards.

[`shoe.go`](internal/shoe/shoe.go) → [`shoe.go`](internal/deck/shoe.go)

- `type Shoe struct { cards []Card; next int; cutIndex int; rng *rand.Rand }`
- `func NewShoe(decks int, rng *rand.Rand) (*Shoe, error)` — validates `1 ≤ decks ≤ 8` (error otherwise), builds `decks × 52` cards.
- `func NewFixedShoe(cards []Card, cutIndex int) *Shoe` — **test seam**: deterministic card order for game/app tests.
- `func (s *Shoe) Shuffle()` — **hand-written Fisher–Yates**: for `i = len-1 … 1`, `j = rng.IntN(i+1)`, swap; resets `next = 0`.
- `func (s *Shoe) Deal() (Card, error)` — pops next card; error when exhausted.
- `func (s *Shoe) NeedsShuffle() bool` — **penetration trigger**: `next >= cutIndex`.
- `func (s *Shoe) Remaining() int`, `func (s *Shoe) CutIndex() int`.
- Penetration = 75% of shoe (`cutIndex = total*3/4`).

Tests: deck size/uniqueness, per-suit counts, `Value()` table, seeded shuffle determinism, shuffle is a permutation, invalid deck counts, cut-card trigger math, exhaustion error.

### 3.2 `internal/game`

[`hand.go`](internal/game/hand.go)

- `type Hand struct { cards []deck.Card; betCents int; fromSplit bool }`
- `Add(deck.Card)`, `Cards()`, `Bet()`, `SetBet()`.
- **Totals:** `Total() int` — sum `Value()`, then while `>21` and aces remain counted as 11, downgrade an ace 11→1. `IsSoft() bool` — any ace still counted as 11. `IsBust() bool` — `Total() > 21`.
- `IsBlackjack() bool` — exactly 2 cards, total 21, **not** `fromSplit`.
- `IsPair() bool` / `PairRank() (deck.Rank, bool)` — 2 cards of equal *value* (10/J/Q/K interchangeable, as in real casinos).

[`engine.go`](internal/game/engine.go)

- `type Action uint8` — `Hit`, `Stand`, `Double`, `Split`; `String()`.
- Money is **integer cents** everywhere (3:2 of a $15 bet = $22.50 — no floats).
- `type Engine struct { shoe *deck.Shoe; rng *rand.Rand }`; internal `draw()` auto-shuffles if the shoe is somehow empty mid-round.
- `type Round struct { hands []*Hand; dealer []deck.Card; holeHidden bool; done bool; initialBetCents int }`
- API used by both CLI modes:
  - `NewRound(betCents int) (*Round, error)` — reshuffle if `NeedsShuffle()`; deal P,D,P,D; **dealer peek** (US rules): if upcard is A or 10-value and hole makes 21 → dealer natural, round settles immediately (player naturals push, all others lose); else player natural → immediate 3:2 win.
  - `ActiveHands() []*Hand`, `LegalActions(i int) []Action`:
    - Hit/Stand always (live hand); **Double** iff exactly 2 cards (DAS — allowed after split, still "first 2 cards" of that hand); **Split** iff 2 equal-value cards **and** `len(hands) < 2` (spec: split into exactly 2 active hands, no resplit).
  - `Apply(i int, Action) error`:
    - Hit → draw; bust closes hand.
    - Stand → closes hand.
    - Double → `bet *= 2`, draw exactly one card, close hand.
    - Split → two hands each bet the original amount; deal one card to each; **split aces receive exactly one card each and auto-stand**; 21 after split is *not* a blackjack.
  - `DealerPlay()` — reveal hole; if any non-busted live player hand exists, dealer draws while `total < 17` (S17: stands on soft 17).
  - `Settle() RoundResult` — per hand: natural `+1.5×bet`; win `+bet`; push `0`; loss/bust `−bet`. Bust loses regardless of dealer outcome.
- `type RoundResult struct { Hands []HandResult; NetCents int; DealerTotal int; DealerBust bool; PlayerNatural bool }`, `HandResult { BetCents, NetCents int; Outcome Win|Lose|Push; IsBlackjack, IsBust bool; Total int }`.

Tests: soft/hard math (A,A / A,A,A / A+K+5 …), blackjack & bust flags, pair detection incl. 10-value mixing, every action + illegal-action errors, split-aces auto-stand, S17 dealer draws (seeded sequences), peek path, all payout paths, deterministic rounds via `NewFixedShoe`.

### 3.3 `internal/strategy`

[`basic.go`](internal/strategy/basic.go) — **S17, DAS, dealer peek, no surrender, no resplit.**

```go
func Decide(h *game.Hand, dealerUp deck.Card, canDouble, canSplit bool) game.Action
```

Tables: `hard[22][12]`, `soft[22][12]`, `pair[14][12]Action` indexed by `[playerTotal|softTotal|pairRank][dealerColumn]` where dealer column = upcard `Value()` (Ace=11). Full matrix below (`H`=Hit `S`=Stand `D`=Double `P`=Split):

```
Dealer upcard:            2  3  4  5  6  7  8  9  10  A
HARD  5–8                 H  H  H  H  H  H  H  H  H  H
HARD  9                   H  D  D  D  D  H  H  H  H  H
HARD  10                  D  D  D  D  D  D  D  D  H  H
HARD  11                  D  D  D  D  D  D  D  D  D  H   (S17)
HARD  12                  H  H  S  S  S  H  H  H  H  H
HARD  13–16               S  S  S  S  S  H  H  H  H  H
HARD  17–21               S  S  S  S  S  S  S  S  S  S

SOFT  A2/A3  (13/14)      H  H  H  D  D  H  H  H  H  H
SOFT  A4/A5  (15/16)      H  H  D  D  D  H  H  H  H  H
SOFT  A6     (17)         H  D  D  D  D  H  H  H  H  H
SOFT  A7     (18)         S  D  D  D  D  S  S  H  H  H
SOFT  A8/A9  (19/20)      S  S  S  S  S  S  S  S  S  S
SOFT  21                  S  S  S  S  S  S  S  S  S  S
SOFT  12     (A,A n/s)    H  H  H  H  H  H  H  H  H  H

PAIR  2,2 / 3,3           P  P  P  P  P  P  H  H  H  H   (DAS)
```

### 3.4 `internal/ui`

[`render.go`](internal/ui/render.go)

- **EV basis:** house-edge convention — `NetEV% = totalNetCents / (rounds × baseBetCents) × 100` (per initial bet; doubles/splits raise variance but the denominator stays the initial wager, matching published house-edge figures ~ −0.5%).
- **Round classification:** net-positive = win, net-negative = loss, net-zero = push (a split round of one win + one loss counts as a push round). Blackjacks tracked separately.
- Bankroll is tracked only in Play mode; the simulator uses pure net accounting over `n` rounds.

## 5. Design Decisions

1. **DAS enabled** — "Double on first 2 cards" applies to post-split 2-card hands; the matrix above is the DAS/S17 chart.
2. **Dealer peek (US rules)** — required for the standard chart's validity; no insurance offered (Basic Strategy never takes it).
3. **Split aces** — one card each, auto-stand; no resplits (spec: exactly 2 active hands).
4. **Integer cents** for all money — exact 3:2 payouts, no floating-point drift.
5. **RNG injection** — `math/rand/v2` `*rand.Rand` threaded through Shoe/Engine/app; deterministic tests via seeds, plus `deck.NewFixedShoe` for scripted scenarios.
6. **Cut card** — 75% penetration; mid-round exhaustion (possible with 1 deck in pathological cases) triggers an emergency in-round shuffle; the cut-card trigger reshuffles between rounds.
7. **go.mod version** — set to the installed toolchain version discovered via `go version` (must be ≥1.22 for `math/rand/v2`; spec floor is 1.26+).

7. `internal/app` play + sim + tests.
8. `main.go` dispatch + `main_test.go`.
9. Acceptance gate: `go run main.go -sim -n 10000`.
10. Acceptance gate: `go test -v -cover ./...` ≥80%.
11. Acceptance gate: `go test -race ./...` zero races; fix and re-run until all green.
